titulo: My Camera Caught the Fresno Nightcrawlers Every Night 📹 #Shorts
titulo_pt: Minha câmera filmou os Nightcrawlers de Fresno toda noite
resumo_pt: Um homem coloca uma câmera no quarto, virada para a porta de vidro do quintal, e toda noite às três ela filma os Nightcrawlers de Fresno (criaturas brancas, só pernas) passando. Ele pede a gravação da câmera do vizinho, que aponta para o mesmo quintal: vazio. A câmera dele estava filmando o reflexo no vidro. Os Nightcrawlers nunca estiveram no quintal: passavam do lado da cama dele todas as noites.
descricao:
Two white legs. No arms. Every night at three a.m. Just not where he thought.

Would you check your own camera tonight?

Follow @VeilFrequency for a new horror story every day. Fictional story based on American folklore. Images are AI-generated.
personagens: the narrator is a man in his forties with short gray hair, glasses and a navy t-shirt, living alone in a small California house; the neighbor is a bald man in his sixties with a white mustache and a Hawaiian shirt; the Fresno Nightcrawlers are pale glowing white creatures about five feet tall, made almost entirely of two long thin legs with a tiny round head and no arms, walking slowly and stiffly
